checks.name: ck_application_rate
checks.sql: annual_rate IS NULL OR annual_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 100

checks.name: ck_document_scope
checks.sql: (kind = 'policy' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND application_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'financial' AND application_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_credit_utilization
checks.sql: utilization_percent IS NULL OR utilization_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100

checks.name: ck_credit_score
checks.sql: reliable_score IS NULL OR reliable_score BETWEEN 300 AND 900

checks.name: ck_evidence_context
checks.sql: (query_id IS NOT NULL AND assessment_id IS NULL) OR (query_id IS NULL AND assessment_id IS NOT NULL)
